title: Action result dialog: the copy button has no accessible name
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzC6RxMfB59EsgAoNN

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect, found by the #27797 card thread's live re-measure (os-dev-report 6526824210, out-of-scope finding) and read on `origin/main` `9f13ee81`.
Business reason: the result dialog is where an administrator receives a one-time value they must hand on: an invite link, a new API key, a 2FA secret. A screen-reader or voice-control user reaches a button announced only as "button", with no name, and can't tell it copies the value or ask for it by name. The value is shown once, so a missed copy means redoing the action.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/app-shell`).
Duplicate search: open issues with "CopyButton" / "copy button accessible name" / "ActionResultDialog aria-label": none. **New.**

## Mechanism (read on `origin/main`)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx` L210 `CopyButton({ value, label })` renders `<Button>` with only a `Copy` / `Check` icon. Only the "Copy all" use (L269) passes a `label`. The per-value uses at L245, L263, L292, L303 and L322 render an icon-only button with no `aria-label` and no visually hidden text.
- The copied state (the `Check` icon) isn't announced either.

## Expected

Every copy button in the result dialog has an accessible name (e.g. "Copy <field label>", from an i18n key in the ten packs), and the copied state is announced (an accessible name change or a polite live region). Pin it with a role-and-name query in the existing result-dialog tests.

## Serial note

`ActionResultDialog.tsx` is inside the live claim on #27521 (row 23, focus handling in the shared action dialogs, claim amendment 6526355417). Dispatch this card after that PR lands, or fold it into that PR by claim amendment.
